title: Lifetimes (basics)
description: Why lifetimes exist: tying references to valid memory.
theory:
## Lifetimes

A **lifetime** is a compile-time region for which a reference is valid. Rust often **elides** lifetimes in simple `fn` signatures; explicit lifetimes appear when the compiler cannot infer a single safe relationship.

### `'static`

String literals have type `&'static str`.

### Shared input lifetimes

When a function returns one of two `&str` inputs, both inputs and the return often share one named lifetime.
